name: Public Records — Audio to text (Whisper) to HTTP
author: Public Records
description: Run publicrecords/audio-file-transcriber on YOUR Apify account via HTTP, then use the transcript, SRT and VTT in later modules. Set APIFY_TOKEN in a Make connection or variable. Do not hard-code a token. Official Make gallery submission needs a Make account and is not included. This Actor transcribes file links; it does not download Instagram, TikTok or YouTube posts.

metadata.notes: Rebuild in Make with the HTTP module if import of this blueprint is rejected; the URL, method, header and body are the recipe.
